name: Forgejo
description: Community-driven soft-fork of Gitea — self-hosted git with an independent governance model and ActivityPub federation roadmap
author: Crow

env_vars.name: FORGEJO_TOKEN
env_vars.description: Personal access token (Settings > Applications > Generate New Token)

env_vars.name: FORGEJO_DISABLE_REGISTRATION
env_vars.description: Leave true so nobody can sign themselves up: with self-registration on and no accounts yet, the first person to register on the web page becomes Forgejo's admin. Crow creates the admin (crow-admin); add other people from the admin panel. Set false only to let people register on their own.

notes: Forgejo is API-compatible with Gitea (v1 REST endpoints). Crow creates Forgejo's admin account (crow-admin) itself at install and saves the password in Settings → Passwords; the web installer at /install is closed by FORGEJO__security__INSTALL_LOCK in the compose file, which existing installs receive at the next gateway start (then Restart the app in Extensions). Log in as crow-admin and generate a personal access token under Settings > Applications for FORGEJO_TOKEN. Git over SSH uses port 2224: clone with ssh://git@host:2224/user/repo.git. Install this bundle if you prefer Forgejo's community-governed, AGPL-licensed fork; install gitea for the upstream project. Running both on the same host is fine — ports do not collide.
